name: Ohio buckeye
desc: Ohio buckeye (Aesculus glabra): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Aesculus glabra, commonly known as Ohio buckeye, Texas buckeye, or fetid buckeye, is a species of tree in the soapberry family (Sapindaceae) native to North America.
